name: Voxel-Aware Masked Ray Sampling
aliases: Hierarchical Sampling for Sparse Feature Volume
NSVF Hierarchical Ray Sampling with Voxel-Aware Masking
definition: A ray sampling strategy for sparse voxel fields that samples points only within intersected voxels, handling variable numbers of intersections per ray by padding and masking, and supporting hierarchical sampling ratios.
summary: Voxel-Aware Masked Ray Sampling is a strategy for sparse voxel fields that restricts sampling to valid voxels, preventing air samples and saving memory compared to standard NeRF.
